entities.summary: Volodymyr Serhiyovych Kravets is a male boxer from Ukraine, who competed for his Eastern European country at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. There he was stopped in the first round of the men's lightweight division by Pakistan's Asghar Ali Shah.
